thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up — quick consumption checkpoint for Vega (token usage + throughput + spend). Can we do a 20-min sync today? I'm pulling the charts now.

alex_eng: I can make 11:30 PT. FYI we rolled v2q yesterday, might affect latency by a few ms.

jin_sre: Quick note from infra: p95 jumped to ~420ms Tue 03:10 UTC; saw `batch_queue_len` spike to 128 during a burst. Correlated with a retry storm.

priya_cs: From Vega ops — finance pinged about a ~12% WoW spend increase after the feature promo. They're asking for a cost breakdown per endpoint.

maria_cs: Thanks. Can someone confirm KV-cache hitrate? Last week we were ~78% which kept token counts down.

alex_eng: Hitrate dropped to ~61% after they started sending more varied prompts. Recommending `cache.prefix_enabled=true` for their main route; should recover hitrate and reduce bill.

jin_sre: Error profile: 4xx are client mal-requests, 5xx stayed <0.2% except the Tue spike. I'll add a short circuit-breaker to limit retries during backpressure.

priya_cs: Customer reported visible degradation during onboarding tests — they have a big spike scheduled next Wed. Need assurance on capacity/canary.

maria_cs: Proposed action items: 1) enable prefix caching, 2) launch a canary route on a dedicated pool for peak window, 3) produce cost-mitigation one-pager for finance. Alex/Jin can you draft a runbook?

alex_eng: On it. Drafting runbook now — will post a gist. Routing config snippet for canary:
```
routes:
  - match: /v1/engines/vega
    pool: dedicated-vega
    fallback: small-gpu
```

jin_sre: Provisioning a small dedicated pool and setting autoscale cap 4->8 for the canary window. ETA EOD. I'll watch for queue metrics.

priya_cs: I'll schedule a 30-min call with Vega ops (Wed 09:00 PT) and prepare the finance brief. Also capturing feedback: they want clearer token attribution per endpoint in invoices.

alex_eng: :thumbsup: will include a note in the runbook about cache metrics to track (hitrate, miss-rate, avg_latency).

maria_cs: Summarizing: enable prefix cache, canary on dedicated pool, runbook + cost one-pager, and renewal risk flagged as elevated in CRM. Any objections?

priya_cs: No objections. Tagging renewal owner for visibility. @lina_sales FYI.

lina_sales: Got it — I'll reach out to Vega and coordinate pricing options and renewal conversation.

deploy-bot: Deployment v2q-hotfix rolled to prod at 2025-11-05T18:10:23Z by alex_eng

maria_cs: Great. I'll DM Vega with the plan and expected cost delta. Will update thread after canary metrics come in.
